decision_types.shared_local_core: Shared procedure or provisional candidate merge
decision_types.contextual_variant: Variant that may preserve core but change mathematical demand or difficulty
decision_types.compound_candidate: Multi-step task with candidate separate procedural identity
decision_types.review_distinct: Distinct target or diagnostic that requires curriculum comparison

Similar-looking error-diagnosis question formats are not automatically shared mathematics
No N3 inferred from complexity or family quotas
Production exercise generators and validated family register unchanged; selected internal difficulty-map assignments updated after teacher review on 2026-11-20.
